posts.title: Image Processing Notes
posts.description: How pictures should be resized, rotated and dithered, and how to judge the result. Three articles: expert notes with the mathematics, measurements and references; a plain-language summary ; and a checklist of best practices and gotchas .

posts.title: Color and HDR Notes
posts.description: What the numbers in a picture mean, from the CIE observers to HDR formats, and how they go wrong. Four articles: expert notes with computed figures and references; a general-audience summary ; a guide to best practices, gotchas and recognizing errors ; and reference tables with formulas.

posts.title: Sampling Theory Notes
posts.description: What the sampling theorem promises, where each of its assumptions fails, and what replaces it. Three articles: expert notes with error budgets and references; a general-audience summary ; and a checklist of best practices and gotchas .
